summary: Mosaic filed an 8-K reporting the expiration and final results of its cash tender offers for four series of debt securities: 4.050% Senior Notes due 2027, 7.30% Debentures due 2028, 5.375% Senior Notes due 2028, and 4.350% Senior Notes due 2029. Offers expired August 14, 2026. Global Bondholder Services served as tender and information agent. The company accepted tendered notes subject to series caps and priority levels. This is a liability management transaction, not a special situation equity event.
